richiami.difetto: The product poses a risk of fire because in vehicles with rear air-conditioning units, there is a risk of a short circuit and consequently of a localised cable fire in the rear interior lighting. Incidents have been reported.
richiami.rimedio: Type of economic operator taking notified measure(s): Other · Category of measure(s): Voluntary corrective actions taken by the manufacturer. · Date of entry into force: Unknown
